description.value: Moda Hotel is a boutique property in a restored 1908 heritage building at the corner of 900 Seymour Street in Vancouver's Arts and Entertainment district, offering 69 chic guestrooms and suites spread across the main building and the adjacent Symphony Place. The hotel has a distinct hip-historic character with exterior murals by internationally recognized graffiti artists alongside original Edwardian architecture. Touring cyclists staying here are a short block from Granville Street and steps from multiple on-site dining venues including the award-winning Cibo Trattoria, Uva Wine Bar, and Red Card Sports Bar.
